UnavailableBody: Your engine could not be reached. Try again shortly.
NotFoundBody: This page is not available. Return to your conversations.
PreviewNote: Sample conversations · sending is not connected yet
SendingUnavailable: Messaging becomes available when an account is connected.
MediaBody: Photos, files and links from your conversations will appear here.
SelectChatBody: Choose a conversation to see its messages.
AccountHelp: Choose an account to manage its connection.
PreviewOnly: Sample content, only in this preview.
ThemeHelp: Follow your device or choose an appearance.
LanguageHelp: Your device language is used unless you choose another.
NoChatsBody: Connect an account or open a conversation to start chatting.
PasswordHelp: Your XMPP account password. It is never shown again here.
EndpointHelp: Leave blank for automatic discovery. For the development server use 127.0.0.1:5222.
TLSFailed: The server certificate could not be verified. Check the server and trusted certificates.
ConnectionFailed: The connection failed. The engine retries transient failures.
AccountSaved: Account saved. Configure its connection below.
ConnectionRequested: Connection requested. Check its current status below.
Disconnected: Account disconnected. Saved history and queued messages are retained.
SubmittedHint: Written to the XMPP connection; recipient delivery and read are not confirmed.
UnknownHint: A transmission may have happened. It is not automatically sent again.
CancelConflict: Cancellation was not applied. Current state:
PendingAcceptance: Acceptance could not be confirmed. Your original text and operation key are kept. Retry to reconcile this submission.
InvalidForm: Check the required fields and try again.
InvalidMessage: Enter a message of up to 16,384 characters.
CSRFError: This form session expired. Reload this page before trying again.
OperationConflict: This operation key already belongs to another request. Review the conversation before creating a new submission.
AccountExists: This account is already registered. Use its existing connection form.
EngineChanged: The selected engine changed. Reload to review its state. Your previous draft stays with its original engine.
LiveRetry: Live updates interrupted; retrying. Your draft is kept.
QueueHelp: This account is offline. Sends are kept in the engine queue until it reconnects.
DraftStorageUnavailable: Device draft storage is unavailable. Keep this window open until your submission is confirmed.
DraftLocked: This submission is awaiting confirmation. Reconcile it before changing its content.
MessageUnavailable: This message or conversation is no longer available. Your draft is kept.
MediaUnavailable: Attachments are not available in this text-chat increment.
NativeError: The request was not completed. Valid values are kept; enter the password again if required.
HistoryUnsupported: The server does not provide accessible history
RoomReadOnly: Saved room: history is available for reading. Joining and sending to rooms are not available yet.
PreviewUnavailable: Preview unavailable. Open the link to view this page.
ImageDownloadFailed: The image could not be downloaded. Try again.
ImageTooLarge: This image exceeds the 32 MiB download limit.
ImageBlocked: This image address cannot be downloaded.
ImageUnsupported: This image format is not supported.
ImageNotFound: This image is no longer available.
AutoImageDownloadsHelp: Images download as you scroll. Turn this off to load them manually. Other files stay on demand.
DevicePreferenceUnavailable: Device storage is unavailable. This setting lasts until the page reloads.
RenderMarkdownHelp: Show quotes, emphasis, lists, links and code on this device. Copy always preserves the original message.
CopyFailed: The message could not be copied.
ImageNotDownloaded: The image has not been downloaded.
StarConflict: The star changed elsewhere. Current state loaded; choose again.
StarUncertain: The star change could not be confirmed. Retry the same change.
StarStorageUnavailable: Star retries are kept in this window only. Reloading may lose an unconfirmed change.
CapabilitiesIntro: Compare Oie, protocol and discovered server support.
CapabilityNotConnected: Not connected. Server support is unknown.
CapabilityEvidenceHelp: These are cached observations, not permission to perform an action. Unknown is not unsupported. Not advertised means discovery did not report the feature. Peer and room support can differ.
CapabilityReadUnavailable: Capability evidence is unavailable. No support has been inferred.
CapabilityServicesHelp: Technical evidence from the account, server and discovered services. This is a bounded snapshot, not a complete inventory.
CapabilityNoServices: No discovery results are available yet.
CapabilityNoNamespaces: No features were advertised in this response.
CapabilitySavedRoomsNote: Read-only retained history; joining and sending are not implemented.
CapabilityProfileImagesNote: Available profile images only; unverified room identities keep initials.
CapabilityFormattingNote: Incoming Markdown rendering; outgoing rich formatting translation is not implemented.
CapabilityReceivedRepliesNote: Viewing and navigating received replies; composing replies is not implemented.
CapabilityLocalNote: Provided by Oie without requiring protocol support.
